title: indigo_mount_lx200: ToupTek SH20 fault reporting from :GES# and speed limit (:SRl/:GRl)
description:
Implement two V1.3 functions of the ATLAS SH20 Developer Protocol (ATLAS_Command_Protocol_V1.3_EN.pdf, firmware 0.5.2.20261029) for the TOUPTEK mount type in indigo_drivers/mount_lx200 (edit the .driver, regenerate).

1. Fault reporting from :GES# (sections 9.2 and 10.1). Reply: ten digits and #. Digits 1-6: brake 0/1, altitude limits 0/1, motor error 0/1, protection 0 clear / 1 acting / 2 ended but locked, initialization 0 incomplete / 1 complete, automatic flip 0 standby / 1 waiting / 2 ready / 3 moving / 4 disabled. Digits 7-10: system code 0000 none, 0003 parking/parked, 0004 home, 0005 goto, 0006 guiding, 0020 motor error, protection or initialization incomplete. Proposal: poll :GES# with the existing TouptTek state update; publish a read-only X_TOUPTEK_STATUS property (motor error, protection, initialization, brake, flip stage) and send an ALERT message when a fault (motor error, protection acting or locked, initialization incomplete) appears or clears. While such a fault is present, refuse new motion (goto, manual move, park, home, guiding) with an alert, as the protocol requires the fault to be resolved first. An unreadable :GES# is unknown state, not a fault and not clear.

2. Speed limit (sections 4.3 and 10.4). :GRl# -> 720# / 1440# / 0#; :SRl720# / :SRl1440# -> 1# / 0#. Proposal: a writable X_TOUPTEK_SPEED_LIMIT switch property (720, 1440), read at connect; change it only while stopped with tracking off (refuse otherwise); after a change read back :GRl#, reselect the current slew-rate preset and read :GRV#. The 720/1440 limit changes what the presets :R8#/:R9# mean (720/1440 vs 360/720); reflect that in the reported rates where the driver shows them. When :GRl# answers 0# (unknown configuration), refuse manual motion with an alert, as the protocol says not to start manual motion then.

Also: bump the driver version, update indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md and indigo_drivers/mount_lx200/PROTOCOL.md (SH20 table, mark the commands as sent), extend the SH20 part of the serial simulator (mount_lx200_simulator) with :GES# fault injection and :SRl/:GRl, and add integration tests in indigo_test/integration/test_mount_lx200_simulator.c covering status decoding, fault alert and motion refusal, speed-limit change and readback, rejection while tracking or moving, and the 0# manual-motion refusal. README.md is not changed without approval. Property names and the motion-refusal policy are proposals for the owner to confirm before implementation.

outcome.summary: Independent review of master...ed0c395e0 (no uncommitted changes). Verified: :GES# decoding matches ATLAS V1.3 sec 9.2 (positions 1-6 brake/alt-limits/motor/protection/init/flip, range-checked, 10 digits; fault = motor error, protection 1 or 2, init 0; unreadable -> IDLE, touptek_fault=false, no clear/new message). :GRl#/:SRl handling per 4.3/10.4: change only with :GTS# 0#, :GU# N and no driver manual motion; readback, preset reselection (lastSlewRate reset, :R9#) and :GRV# ordering confirmed by the test. :GRl# read before each manual move (sec 4.2 step 2), 0# refuses it and leaves neither item selected with ALERT. Fault refusal covers goto (meade_slew), manual motion, park, home and both guide axes; all changes are gated on MOUNT_TYPE_TOUPTEK_ITEM, no other dialect affected. Regenerating indigo_mount_lx200.driver with the unchanged generator reproduces the checked-in .c/.h/_main.c byte for byte; no generator change. Version 90->91. PROPERTIES.md and PROTOCOL.md describe the delivered behavior accurately. MIGRATION_STATUS.md changes only the Automated Tests (Sim/HW) status column 180->184; Comment untouched. Formatting conforms. Ran test_mount_lx200_simulator in the worktree: all 181 table cases passed, including the 4 new ones, which do exercise the claimed scenarios (each of four fault kinds with ALERT + message, refusals with no MS/Mn/Me/MP1/MH sent, DROP of :GES# giving IDLE without messages, guider-only fault refusal with :GES# read per pulse, :SRl/:GRl/:R9/:GRV order, rejection by mount, while tracking and while moving, 0# refusal persisting over reconnect). Test build cleaned. Non-blocking notes for the owner: (1) indigo_mount_lx200.driver:3229 sends the fault-cleared message as OK, while the confirmed ticket text says an ALERT message when a fault appears or clears; OK is the more sensible state but it is a deviation the owner may want to confirm.
